content_sections.heading: About IIT Hyderabad Nano-X
content_sections.text: Nano-X at IIT Hyderabad is a 2000 sq. ft fabrication centre housing semiconductor manufacturing tools in a Class 10000 (1500 sq. ft) and a Class 1000 (500 sq. ft) cleanroom. The X in Nano-X stands for electronic/photonic/MEMS devices. Its equipment is used for the main semiconductor processing steps, such as lithography, deposition, etching and bonding, for research and academic purposes.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one set of requirements for the single Research Associate post. PhD in Electonics/Physics/Photonics/Equivalent. At least 10 years of experience in academic/industrial R&D in technical roles involving fabrication and characterisation of electronic/MEMS/Photonic/Spintronic devices. Demonstrated ability to mentor PhD students in nanofabrication and characterisation. Knowledge of nanofabrication techniques such as deposition, etching and lithography, with hands-on experience working with the facilities, is preferred. Knowledge and hands-on experience of electrical, optical and material characterisation of semiconductor/photonic nano-devices. Working experience of epitaxial growth and characterization of HEMT/photonic devices is desirable. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice states that emoluments will be commensurate with DST norms for Research Associate positions. No amount is printed. The tenure is 11 months, extendable up to a total of 3 years. The expected joining date is 1 December 2026. The hired staff member will report to the faculty team supervising the cleanroom facility.

content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Research Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: Operations, troubleshooting, and user training on semiconductor process equipment, such as deposition, etching, and lithography tools, in the NanoX cleanroom. Electrical, optical and material characterisation of semiconductor devices. Monitor process quality and develop new processes, documentation, and consumable management. The candidate is expected to give technical inputs for research and industrial projects, and work with IITH PhD students for their nanofabrication needs.
